release_notes:
Fixed build for Waze 5.25.90.900.

### Fixed
* Config overrides are only injected for keys the build declares, so Waze 5.25.90.900 starts without the NoSuchFieldError crash

### New
* **Keep Waze alive on Android Auto**: keeps Waze running after you disconnect from the car (adjustable, default 10 minutes)
* **Morphe YouTube Music as a Waze audio partner**: Waze's hidden audio-extension switches are now forced on, so the partner shows up without waiting on Waze's server flags

### App support
* Waze 5.25.90.900 (1030741) supported, verified end to end (all 29 rows)

Full diff: [v0.22.7...v0.22.8](https://github.com/Forsigh/waze-patches/compare/v0.22.7...v0.22.8)
